title_en: For sale!! Apartment 4+1+3 with Yard, in Dream House Residence!!
description_en: An exclusive 4+1+3 typology apartment is offered for sale, located on the 0th residential floor of Building B, in the Dream House Residence, a modern residential project near the Zoo, ideal for families looking for space, privacy and maximum comfort. Main details: Floor 0 residential, Building B Apartment area: 170.5 m² Yard area: 250 m² Regular cubature and highly functional layout Orientation South-East-West, for natural lighting throughout the day Apartment height: 3.2 m Organization: Distribution corridor Separate living room Separate kitchen 4 bedrooms 3 bathrooms Veranda surrounding apartment, with direct access to the courtyard. The building is under construction and is expected to be completed within 2027, offering contemporary construction standards and a quality living environment in one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana. For more information and details, please contact us.
